notes.text: Latte: 12 g of this (#39, El Salvador Finca Miravalles, 17 days since roasting) + 6 g of #41 (Honduran MWP decaf, 14 days). Ground a bit too coarse: 36 g out in only 18 s (counted from pulling the handle; Lelit Bianca at 201 F, pressure ramped up slowly for the first 8 s, dropped to 4 bar after 22 s). "It's good, but not amazing."
